h1: Tube and profile laser cutting machines — Ø0.3″ to 25.2″, 20 to 49 ft bars, 1.5 to 40 kW
intro: A tube laser cuts round, square, rectangular and open profiles to length and cuts the holes, copes, slots and notches in them in one pass — no saw, no drill, no notcher, no layout — straight from the 3D model. NovoTech sells two kinds in Canada, each on its own page: tube laser cutters for tube to Ø14″ with two or three chucks on 20 to 39 ft bars — the premium E-FTL with 1 G servo chucks made in Turkey, NovoTech's value-line ULT and the T series, high-speed PLUS and bevel-cutting GT; and heavy-duty tube and profile lasers with three and four chucks for structural tube, pipe and beams to Ø25″, 6,600 lb and 49 ft, plus the H-beam profile line. For trailer, railing, furniture, agricultural, HVAC and steel-construction work. Below, the two kinds compared and every model in one table of tube range, power, speed and bar length; every machine comes with a CSA-approved panel, chiller, tube nesting software, a 1-year warranty and installation, training and parts from Mississauga, ON, Canada.
hero_points: Tube laser cutters: premium E-FTL Ø0.3″ – 13.8″, 1 G, ±0.05 mm; value ULT Ø0.4″ – 14.2″ two or three chucks; T / PLUS / GT Ø0.5″ – 14″ — 20 – 39 ft bars, 1.5 – 40 kW
Heavy-duty: premium FTL Ø0.6″ – 25.2″, bars to 39.4 ft and 5,732 lb; NT zero-tailing, ST / HT three- and four-chuck lasers to Ø25″, 6,600 lb and 49 ft
Bundle loaders, following supports, ±45° bevel heads, STEP / IGES import and tube nesting on every machine
hero_brand_line: Dener Makina builds the premium lasers in Kayseri, Turkey (since 1974, Dener Canada in Mississauga, ON, Canada); NovoTech's own value line is built in China to our specification; Senfeng Laser builds its value line in Jinan, China (CE / FDA / ETL). All sold, installed and supported in Canada by NovoTech.

faq.q: Tube laser cutter or heavy-duty tube laser — which should I buy?
faq.a: By the biggest bar you cut. A two- or three-chuck tube laser cutter covers tube to Ø14″ on 20 to 39 ft bars — railing, furniture, trailer, HVAC, agricultural and most steel-construction work — and is the machine most shops need; the premium E-FTL and the value-line ULT, T and PLUS are on one page, side by side. A heavy-duty machine with three or four chucks holds beams and pipe to Ø25″, bars of 2,600 – 3,000 kg and 49 ft, and cuts them without tailing — for structural steel, pipe and heavy profiles. Both kinds load from a bundle, support the bar as it is cut and take bevel heads.

The premium Dener E-FTL and FTL are built in Turkey with 1 G servo chucks, Precitec heads, ±0.05 mm and Dener Canada parts in Mississauga, ON, Canada — for the shop that runs the tube laser all day. NovoTech's value-line ULT and the Senfeng T / PLUS / GT / NT / ST / HT are built in China with pneumatic chucks, in a wider range of sizes and powers at a lower price; NovoTech stocks the parts and does the service. The premium machine is faster between parts and holds tighter tolerance at high duty.

faq.q: What can a tube laser cut?
faq.a: Round, square, rectangular, oval and open profiles — angle, channel, flat bar — in mild steel, stainless, aluminum, copper and brass, from the chuck's minimum to its maximum size, in wall thicknesses to about 1/2″ (12 kW) or 3/4″ (20 kW). Holes, slots, copes for tube-to-tube joints, tabs and notches for folding, engraving — anything you can draw on the surface of the profile. A 5-axis or 45° bevel head adds weld preparations and mitred corners.

Two chucks (Dener E-FTL / FTL, NovoTech ULT, Senfeng T / PLUS) hold the bar at both ends and cover tube to Ø25″ — the machine most shops need. A third chuck in the middle (NovoTech ULT three-chuck, Senfeng NT) takes over the bar as it shortens, so the last part is cut without a tail. Three and four chucks on the heavy machines (Senfeng ST / HT) carry 49 ft bars of 6,600 lb without sag for structural sections and towers.

From a bundle: the automatic loader separates one bar, measures it and feeds it to the rear chuck; the front chuck and following supports hold the bar as it is cut; finished parts drop onto the unloading table or conveyor and the remnant is ejected. One operator runs the machine while loading the next bundle. Loading lengths of 7, 9 and 12 m — or manual loading on the small Senfeng T series.

The CNC imports STEP / IGES solid models of the tube parts, unfolds them onto the profile, nests them along the bar to use the remnant and writes the program — with the cutting database for the material and seam detection to orient welded tube. Offline programming on a PC is standard on both lines.

A 7 m machine needs about 20 m (65 ft) of length including the loader and unloader; a 12 m machine about 30 m. 600 V 3-phase with the supplied transformer or 480 V, a chiller (included), assist gas and a dust collector. We lay the machine out for your building before you order.

faq.q: What voltage do these machines run on?
faq.a: Three-phase machines are supplied for 600 V as standard with a CSA-approved panel; 208 V, 240 V and 480 V 3-phase are available on request, and 240 V single-phase on models whose main motor is 2.2 kW (3 HP) or less — a machine with a motor above 2.2 kW must run on three-phase power and cannot be converted to 240 V single-phase. Manual machines have no electrics.
